content:
Clara (Growth): Quick plan: rolling out the 'Inference Performance Report' + companion webinar. Want a concise newsletter + 3-step drip for registrants and a 2-step rescue flow for people who click but drop off. Focus: RSVP lift and trial signups.
Diego (Lifecycle): Proposed slices: VIP (Enterprise/AE engaged), Active (visited docs/pricing in 30d), Passive (landed & registered). Rescue: 'clicked but not registered' bucket for AB test.
Rina (Content): Draft outline: Confirm = calendar + 1-pager PDF + 2 key charts. Reminder = 48h: 3 bullet TL;DR + speaker line. Day-of = 1hr push with single CTA + ask for questions. Rescue flow: 1) finish-signup nudge 2) highlight email with 1 chart + CTA.
Priya (Design): I'll prepare two layouts: 'data panel' (large chart) and 'product action' (trial CTA prominence). Also tiny variant for Dedicated/Private customers with enterprise CTA.
Owen (Analytics): UTM schema: utm_campaign=inference_report_launch_v1&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter. Lead scoring: click +3, rsvp +7, attend +20. Targets: VIP RSVP 22%, Active 12%, Passive 3%. Audience est ~44k total (~4k VIP, ~12k active).
Clara (Growth): Send windows: use localization rolls: APAC 10:30 local, Americas 10am local, EMEA 11am CET. Avoid Tue mornings for VIP. Also want a small 'share with colleague' CTA that adds referral tag.
Diego (Lifecycle): Automation: if tag `rsvp=true` -> add to nurture campaign `inference_nurture_v1`. Rescue webhook for clicks -> /hooks/finish-signup. Also route Dedicated clicks to /ae/hand-off.
Rina (Content): Subject A/B ideas: A:"New Inference Performance Report — 2 charts you need" B:"How teams shipped faster: inference benchmarks" C(short):"Inference report + webinar". Preheader tests and personalization token for company name.
Priya (Design): I'll provide desktop + mobile HTML and an AMP-lite RSVP button for mobile quick rsvps. Also create a 600x200 chart image alt for email clients.
Owen (Analytics): We'll seed 60 internal addresses for QA (growth, sales, eng, cs). I'll build a live dashboard: RSVP, CTR, click->rsvp conversion, trial starts (7d). Plan to run subject-lift test using RSVP as primary metric.
Clara (Growth): No-show flow: immediate recording email within 24h + 10-day follow-up with use-case snippets and a trial CTA. Also a 2-week follow-up for high-value leads with AE outreach.
Diego (Lifecycle): Owners: Clara (campaign lead), Diego (flows & routing), Rina (copy), Priya (creative), Owen (metrics). Deadline: final assets + test sends by Friday EOD.
engage-bot: Created ticket MK-5300 -> campaign config, seedlist, and routing. Link: https://app.redwood/boards/MK-5300 :white_check_mark:
Rina (Content): I'll post subject/body drafts to the doc by EOD tomorrow.
Owen (Analytics): :thumbsup: will set up dashboard and send the seedlist once HTML is ready.
Clara (Growth): Great — let's try to keep the confirm email short and mobile-first. If we can get test sends in by Thursday, we can iterate before Friday deployment.
